hypotheses.C1_layer0_rank1_roles: Across high-effect FineWeb contexts, median first-component role-direction energy is at least 0.70 at layer 0.
hypotheses.C2_depth_role_rank_gap: Layer 17 median first-component role-direction energy is at least 0.08 below layer 0.
hypotheses.C3_low_dimensional_roles: Four role components capture at least 0.90 median direction energy at both layers on FineWeb.
hypotheses.C4_ood_role_subspaces: Mean top-four canonical overlap with FineWeb is at least 0.65 for both OOD corpora at both layers.
hypotheses.C5_diagonal_role_at_high_effect: Median absolute cosine of high-effect contextual roles with the isolated diagonal role is at least 0.85 at layer 0 and 0.70 at layer 17.
